projects.title: Xélle.ng
projects.description: I built XELLE end-to-end for a Nigerian high-end lifestyle brand everything from the database schema to the admin dashboard. The brief was simple: make it reliable enough that payment failures and overselling are never the client's problem. That shaped every technical decision on the project.
projects.problem: A high-end lifestyle brand selling through DMs and bank transfers can oversell stock, lose track of who has paid, and leave customers guessing where their order is.
features: A full storefront: shop, product pages, search and checkout, priced in naira.
Atomic stock deduction in Postgres (per product and per variant), so two buyers can never take the last item.
An order queue that caps concurrent order writes, so a sales rush can't overload the database.
Stockpile: pay now, ship later. Items build up across orders for 14 days and ship together for one delivery fee.
Delivery pricing by zone: four Lagos zones plus interstate, doorstep or hub pickup, all editable from the admin.
Bank-transfer and WhatsApp payment with an admin confirmation step, plus order tracking and status emails.
Verified-purchase reviews, with review links emailed after delivery and admin moderation.
A 14-section admin: orders, inventory with low-stock alerts, coupons, customers, analytics and a rich-text CMS.

steps.title: Browse
steps.body: Customer shops the catalogue; prices and stock come live from Postgres.

steps.title: Order
steps.body: Checkout goes through the order queue, which deducts stock atomically.

steps.title: Pay
steps.body: Customer pays by bank transfer or WhatsApp; the admin confirms it.

steps.title: Ship
steps.body: Delivery fee is set by zone; the order ships now or waits in a stockpile.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.body: Status emails go out at each step, then a verified review link after delivery.

projects.title: Zuta ya
projects.description: ZúTa Ya started as a meat delivery brief and grew into something much larger. By the time it shipped, it was a unified platform handling a storefront, butchery services, a grill house menu, event bookings, subscriptions, and a full operations backend all in one codebase.
projects.problem: A Lagos meat business was running four businesses at once (a shop, a grill house, butchery and event services, and subscriptions), and every one of them had to share the same stock, money and delivery slots without anything going out of sync.
features: One codebase for the shop, packaged meat boxes, the Kitchen grill-house menu, outdoor butchery, Owambe event planning and bookings.
Atomic order creation in one Postgres transaction: it locks rows, deducts stock and rolls everything back if anything is short.
A Paystack payment ledger that records every attempt. Verify, webhook and cron race safely, and only the one that wins runs fulfilment.
Automatic payment recovery: a reconciliation cron, stock that restores exactly once, and one-time resume links for abandoned checkouts.
Overpayments and underpayments refunded automatically, with an append-only event log for every payment.
Recurring meat-box subscriptions charged on saved Paystack authorisations.
Cost snapshotted on every order line, so margin and COGS stay accurate when supplier prices change.
A 25-route admin covering orders, payments, disputes, delivery capacity, newsletters, an audit log, cron logs and analytics.

steps.title: Cart
steps.body: Cuts and packages go into the cart; packages expand into the real stock they use.

steps.title: Order
steps.body: create_order_atomic locks rows, deducts stock and saves the order in one transaction.

steps.title: Pay
steps.body: Paystack popup; verify, webhook and cron race, and one atomic update decides the winner.

steps.title: Fulfil
steps.body: The order is confirmed, a receipt is emailed and the admin is notified within 30 seconds.

steps.title: Recover
steps.body: Abandoned payments: stock restored once, customer emailed a resume link.

projects.title: Chatmate
projects.description: Student mental health services are stretched thin. This platform gives students a private, always available space to talk and knows exactly when the conversation needs a human instead.
projects.problem: Students often need someone to talk to at 2am, long before a counsellor is free, and a chatbot that misses a crisis is worse than having none at all.
features: Chatmate, a warm AI companion on Gemini that reflects feelings back before it offers any perspective.
Replies stream in token by token, with automatic fallback to another model when one is rate-limited.
Crisis handling: talk of self-harm or danger triggers a calm response and real Nigerian helplines (MANI, 24/7).
One-tap escalation that hands the conversation to a human counsellor.
A counsellor dashboard with pending and resolved cases, resolution notes and average response time.
Conversation export to PDF, so a student can take the conversation to a professional.
No accounts needed to start talking.

steps.title: Talk
steps.body: Student opens the chat, with no forms in the way.

steps.title: Listen
steps.body: Gemini answers using a carefully written listening-first system prompt, streamed live.

steps.title: Detect
steps.body: Signs of a crisis trigger safe wording and helplines.

steps.title: Escalate
steps.body: Student hands the conversation to a human in one tap.

steps.title: Resolve
steps.body: A counsellor picks up the case from the dashboard and records the outcome.
